description: Na₂CrTi(PO₄)₃ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.60 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are three shorter (2.62 Å) and three longer (2.71 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.92 Å) and three longer (2.01 Å) Ti-O bond lengths. Cr is bonded to six O atoms to form CrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.97 Å) and three longer (1.98 Å) Cr-O bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent TiO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent CrO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 11-48°. There are two shorter (1.53 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Ti, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Ti and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na, one Cr, and one P atom.
